title: SEKA ExAero GR current stiffness and compliance statement recheck
notes: The manufacturer page states up to 16 mm seatpost movement and 106 N/mm rear vertical compliance, claiming this improves vibration damping without compromising power transfer or lateral stiffness. This vertical-compliance figure is a different axis and test basis from Cycling Weekly's single large-frame lateral-flex observation; no universal stiffness score or threshold is supplied.
